sloka: सो ऽङ्गदं निशितैर्बाणैस्तदा विव्याध वेगितः।शरीरदारणैस्तीक्ष्णैः कालाग्निसमविग्रहैः ।। ६.७६.५ ।।

translations.english: He (Sonitaksha) swiftly pierced with pointed shafts resembling fire raging at the time of dissolution and struck Angada with arrows known by names, Ksura, Ksurapra, Naracha, Vatsadanta, Silimukha, Karni, Salya, vipada and many sharp arrows.
